title.en: The Jingyuan Mutiny and the court at Fengtian

summary.en:
In 783, a mutiny in the capital forced the Tang emperor Dezong to leave Chang’an for Fengtian. The imperial court depended on commanders and troops whose loyalties could shift. At Fengtian, the emperor had to defend a refuge while recovering the cooperation needed to govern.

Why this matters: Tang’s survival after the An Lushan Rebellion involved repeated negotiations with regional military powers. A map colored for Tang can conceal how much authority depended on those relationships.
summary.zh:
783年，京师兵变迫使唐德宗离开长安，出奔奉天。朝廷依赖的将领与军队并非始终服从。德宗既要守住奉天，又要重新争取维持统治所需的支持。

这件事有何意义：安史之乱后的唐朝必须反复与地方军事力量协调。地图上的唐朝色块，难以呈现朝廷对这些关系的依赖。

title.en: Chu and Jingnan along the middle Yangtze
title.zh: 楚与荆南：长江中游的政权与商路

summary.en:
Ma Yin received the title King of Chu in 927. His court was based in Tanzhou, today’s Changsha. Nearby Jingnan was centered at Jiangling. The two centers sat on connected waterways, but they belonged to different political authorities.

Read this alongside the northern succession. The Five Dynasties describe a sequence of northern courts. The southern kingdoms and their trade networks followed their own timelines.
summary.zh:
927年，马殷受封楚王，治所在潭州，即今长沙。邻近的荆南以江陵为中心。两地水路相通，却分属不同政权。

可以将此事与北方政权交替对读。五代是北方朝廷先后更替的序列，南方诸国与商贸网络则有各自的发展节奏。

summary.en:
In 932, the Later Tang court undertook a project to print the Nine Classics through its educational administration. Cutting the text into woodblocks required selecting an edition and committing resources to its reproduction. The date marks an initiative, rather than the completion of all its volumes.

The project shows how courts could use printing to transmit a shared scholarly tradition even in a period of political fragmentation.
summary.zh:
932年，后唐朝廷经由教育机构启动九经刊刻工程。将文字刻入版木，既要选定底本，也要投入人力与物资。这个年份标记工程的启动，全部卷册并非当年刊成。

这项工程说明，即使政权分立，朝廷也能通过印刷传播共同的经学传统。

title.en: The debate on salt and iron

summary.en:
In 81 BCE, a court debate in Chang’an examined the state’s role in salt and iron. Government monopolies could raise revenue and support frontier commitments. Critics questioned their burden on households and the place of government in trade and production.

Set this beside the Atlas’s Western Han expansion dates. Campaigns and commanderies also depended on how the court raised and spent revenue. The surviving literary account presents opposing arguments through a later text.
summary.zh:
公元前81年，西汉朝廷在长安讨论国家在盐铁经营中的角色。官营专卖可以增加收入、支撑边疆开支，批评者则质疑它给民户带来的负担，也追问官府应在贸易和生产中扮演什么角色。

把盐铁之议与图鉴中的西汉扩张节点并读，可以看到征战和设置郡县也取决于朝廷怎样筹措与支出财赋。传世文本以后出的文学形式呈现双方论辩。
